summary: Create one Harbor Logistics, LLC company as a current NOVA Infrastructure Fund I transportation-infrastructure platform from the December 2021 Premier acquisition. Retain ATS and A&R as underlying acquired operations, including A&R's July 2025 combination into the surviving Harbor brand. Harbor's April 2026 owner statement confirms NOVA's continuing ownership, and no later transfer was found.
nonblockingDisclosureGaps: The exact legal platform-formation date, intermediate ownership vehicle and NOVA percentage stake are not publicly disclosed.
Any management or seller rollover and the exact Premier, ATS and A&R seller economics are not publicly disclosed.
recommendedActions: Create one canonical Harbor Logistics, LLC company with an active NOVA Infrastructure Fund I owner period from December 2021.
Preserve Premier as the foundation acquisition and ATS and A&R as underlying acquired operations rather than separate current PortCos.
Use the April 2026 Harbor statement as current direct ownership evidence and retain the NOVA portfolio page as manager-level corroboration.
Do not create ownership records for ports, railroads, regulators, customers, landlords, lenders or other commercial counterparties.
